title: SCE 1.3: Preventive Probe - Malicious CodeBuild Project Prevention
description: Validates that IAM preventive controls (explicit deny policies) block attackers from creating a malicious CodeBuild project with privileged mode enabled for credential exfiltration. Tests defense against T1552.005 (Unsecured Credentials in CodeBuild environment).

steady-state-hypothesis.title: CodeBuild Malicious Project Creation is Blocked by IAM Preventive Controls
steady-state-hypothesis.description: When explicit deny policies are in place, an attacker cannot create a CodeBuild project with privileged mode enabled to exfiltrate credentials.

method.name: deploy-preventive-control-infrastructure
method.description: Deploy CloudFormation stack with IAM role, explicit deny policies, and S3 artifact bucket

method.name: execute-malicious-codebuild-creation-attack
method.description: Attempt to create a CodeBuild project with privileged mode=True and credential exfiltration buildspec

rollbacks.name: cleanup-experiment-resources
rollbacks.description: Delete CloudFormation stack and all provisioned resources
